outside_universe_note: Registered four-year schools that are not Title IV participants (PSET4FLG not 1); the registry scope does not require Title IV.

reasons.administrative_unit: System, district or board office (IPEDS INSTCAT -2): reports to IPEDS but enrolls no students.
reasons.category_not_reported: IPEDS INSTCAT -1 (not reported): held for a manual check of whether undergraduate degrees are awarded.
reasons.for_profit: Private for-profit (IPEDS CONTROL 3): outside the product scope (public and private nonprofit).
reasons.graduate_degrees_only: IPEDS INSTCAT 1: degree-granting, graduate degrees only (undergraduate courses without an undergraduate degree).
reasons.graduate_only: Offers no undergraduate instruction (UGOFFER not 1): graduate and professional schools.
reasons.other: Excluded by the registry scope rule for another reason; see the row.
